species.name: Petrelash

dex.text: Tiny, dark and walking on water as if it had a permit. Appears out of the spray and is gone before you can say its name.
dex.fact: The storm petrel may be named after St Peter, who walked on water, because it seems to patter across the waves.

species.real: Storm petrels nest inside the drystone walls of the Broch of Mousa in Shetland, an Iron Age tower about 2,000 years old, and only come and go after dark.

species.name: Tempestrel

dex.text: A petrel that has stopped asking the storm for permission. Skims the swell by night and arrives like bad news with good manners.
dex.fact: Storm petrels come ashore only at night, to nest in burrows and rock crevices on remote islands, so the gulls do not see them.

species.real: A storm petrel weighs about as much as a sparrow, yet can live for thirty years or more, much of it spent far out over the Atlantic.
